name: Those Blasted Troggs!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Those Light-blasted troggs, turning my work site into a wreck! Look at that, there goes another barrel of powder!

Ohhh, I wish I could go down there and wring every one of their scrawny little necks! I want to kill them all!

This can't be good for my health, all this stress and anger... What have they left me with? Nothing!

I'd kill them myself, but my aim's no good anymore! You go into the quarry and kill some of the filthy buggers! I'll pay you! Just hurt them, kill them!
narrative.objectives: Kill 6 Rockjaw Skullthumpers for Foreman Stonebrow at the Gol'Bolar quarry.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Well, that makes me feel a little better...

But I won't be happy until they're all dead! All of them!
narrative.requestItemsText: It makes me so mad! Grrr...
